answer_verbatim:

Meanwhile, here are quick ways to find reliable backflow testers and what to check:

Where to look
- City of Liberty Utilities or Public Works website — many cities publish lists of approved/registered backflow testers.
- Google Maps / Yelp — search “backflow testing Liberty MO” or “backflow tester Kansas City area.”
- Local plumbing companies and irrigation companies — many certified plumbers and irrigation specialists do backflow testing.
- National/local chains that serve KC (e.g., Roto-Rooter, Mr. Rooter franchises) often provide testing and repair.

What to ask/verify when you call
- Are you certified to test backflow preventers in Missouri? (Ask for their tester or certification number.)
- Do you have a Missouri plumbing license and insurance?
- Do you handle repairs on-site if the device fails? What are typical repair costs?
- Will you file the required test report with Liberty Utilities (if required)? Ask for a copy of the test certificate after the job.

Typical cost & logistics
- Testing usually runs about $75–$150 per device; repairs and parts are extra.
- An annual test is commonly required for commercial devices and many irrigation systems.
- Testing takes 15–45 minutes per device (longer if repairs are needed).

If you want, I can search and list several specific certified testers and their phone numbers near Liberty, MO — tell me if you want residential or commercial and I’ll pull results.
